rule.description: Production code which can never be selected at runtime because it is kept reachable only by compatibility switches that are permanently disabled (zero-argument selectors whose every explicit return folds to a falsy module-level constant), by comparison against members retired from the dispatch enum, or because all of its references live inside such never-taken paths; together with the switches themselves and references to modules or names of the analyzed package which no longer exist.

checks.description: A module-level zero-argument function whose every explicit return expression folds to a falsy constant, so it can only ever report that the old pipeline is disabled.
checks.detected_relation: permanently disabled compatibility switch -> guard it controls
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The selector can never select anything; every path guarded by it is dead code that future readers must still maintain and keep type-checking.

matches.evidence: the only return is `LEGACY_COMPATIBILITY_LEVEL >= 2`, and LEGACY_COMPATIBILITY_LEVEL is the module constant 0, so the selector always folds to False.
the only return is `LEGACY_COMPATIBILITY_LEVEL >= 1`, which folds to False at module level.
the only return is `LEGACY_COMPATIBILITY_LEVEL >= 1`, which folds to False at module level.
the only return is `LEGACY_COMPATIBILITY_LEVEL >= 2`, which folds to False at module level.
the only return is `LEGACY_COMPATIBILITY_LEVEL >= 1`, which folds to False at module level.

checks.description: An if/elif whose guard folds to a permanently disabled compatibility switch (directly, or through a short-circuited conjunction with one), so the guarded region can never run.
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: Every statement in the guarded region is unreachable at runtime; keeping the region makes the live control flow harder to follow and preserves implementations that no longer match the requested behavior.

matches.evidence: the dispatch chain keeps an elif for the removed pre-12 'results' subcommands behind `use_legacy_command_names() and args.subcommand in ['results', 'results-all']`; the guard short-circuits on the disabled switch.

the comparator assembly keeps a first branch requiring the retired pre-12 comparison mode, guarded by `use_legacy_comparator() and compare_mode == CompareMode.LEGACY_NORM_MATCH`; the switch makes the whole conjunction fold to False.
the verdict printout keeps a branch rendering the outputs in the old plain-diff format, guarded by `use_legacy_rendering()`.
the diff renderer keeps its pre-12 plain rendering as a gated head, guarded by `use_legacy_rendering()`.
the format-string expansion keeps a pre-12 rule set accepting the download-style specifiers, guarded by `use_legacy_format()`.
the format-string parser keeps the pre-12 singleton aliasing before building the pattern, guarded by `use_legacy_format()`.
the history lookup keeps an importer for the pre-12 single-JSON history file, guarded by `use_legacy_history()` inside the missing-path branch.

checks.description: A comparison whose right side is an attribute of an enum class of the analyzed package that the enum does not define; the selection can never pass (and the guard would fail loudly if reached).
checks.detected_relation: comparison member not defined by the dispatch enum -> unreachable mode branch
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The branch references a mode the current dispatch enum retired; no input can select it, so the branch (and the selectors behind it) exist only to be skipped.

matches.evidence: the mode dispatch keeps an elif for `CompareMode.LEGACY_NORM_MATCH`, but CompareMode defines no such member; the arm constructs the legacy comparator that exists only for it.

checks.description: A function or class of the analyzed package whose every reference occurs inside a never-taken path (or inside another gate-kept symbol), so nothing can ever execute it.
checks.detected_relation: gate-kept symbol -> all references inside never-taken paths
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The symbol survives only because the retired branches mention it; deleting the branches without deleting the symbol leaves code with no caller at all.

matches.evidence: the body of the old 'results' subcommand; its only reference is the never-taken dispatch elif, and it is the only user of the newly added json import in this module.
the pre-12 plain renderer; referenced only from the gated head of the current renderer and from the never-taken presentation branch in the test subcommand.
renders tokens without colors for the old pipeline; referenced only from within make_pretty_diff_legacy, itself gate-kept.
the Unicode-normalizing pre-12 comparator class; its only references are the retired-mode arms in the comparator dispatch (both never-taken), and this module imports unicodedata solely for it.
expands format strings under the pre-12 rules; its only reference is the gated head of percentformat.
reads the pre-12 single-JSON history file; its only reference is the gated branch in DownloadHistory.get, reached only when the history path does not exist yet.

excluded.reason: Deprecated color helpers with zero references exist in the pinned clean baseline; the rule requires at least one reference and deadness tied to a never-taken path, so these pre-existing orphans are intentionally not reported.
Imported for a packaging side effect rather than for its attributes; it is not dead code and the rule cannot classify it as gate-kept.

symbols: else: assert False arms in the enum dispatches
excluded.reason: Defensive fall-through asserts follow all enum members and are part of normal defensive style; they are not guarded by any selector and stay out of the rule.
